verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents a few product-owned behaviors that run without manual intervention: scheduled Pix/TED transfers, automatic splitting of inbound funds on arrival, recurring Pix collection after one-time authorization, and automated reconciliation of online sales. These are fixed, narrow banking features rather than a general facility for users to define their own autonomous background automations, so they earn only glancing credit. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or rules engine, triggers and conditions for custom workflows, agent-driven background execution, monitoring and controls for running automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
